review: Independent scoped procedure re-review of EXT-F-4071 through EXT-F-4086

included: The 16 named inventory cases and their setup, valid and negative inputs, expected observations, variants, cleanup, readiness gaps, and verification status
Relevant handler schemas and behavior in src/lib/tools/handlers/tabs.ts and active-tab fallback in src/lib/tools/handlers/_active-tab.ts
The stated manual Tools runner boundary and same-window fixture instructions
excluded: Browser execution, build or reload, product and inventory changes, database reads, agent dispatch and live binding validation, and sibling stabilization records

addressed.finding: Same-window setup and returned window-id checks were implicit in concrete setup recipes.
addressed.evidence: All 16 cases now identify WINDOW_ID from the active tab in the dedicated window, prescribe window_id on disposable open_new_tab calls, and require returned window-id matching. Cases 4073, 4078, 4079, 4081, and 4083-4086 show explicit checks in setup examples. Remaining recipes defer to the universal precondition, which still makes the invariant explicit.

addressed.finding: History procedures did not create a second active owned tab.
addressed.evidence: 4078 and 4079 create the history tab and a second same-window tab with explicit window_id, verify the second returned window id, and make it active before targeting the history tab by id.

addressed.finding: Several important optional and union forms lacked reproducible variants.
addressed.evidence: 4071 exercises index and window_id; 4072 exercises scalar and array close_tab forms; 4077 exercises omitted tab_id with active-tab fallback and distinguishes assigned-agent behavior; 4081 exercises destination window_id; 4083 exercises create_tab_group window_id. Each form matches the source schema.

not_addressed.finding: The 16 procedures are not exhaustive coverage of optional schema variants.
not_addressed.evidence: Handler source declares tab_id optional for go_back and go_forward (4078-4079), set_tab_zoom (4080), and resize_window (4082), but each valid manual-run input supplies tab_id. The procedures discuss assigned-tab fallback, yet do not include an omitted-tab manual-run variant for these four controls. Some optional defaults also are not independently varied.

A_procedure_correctness_and_coverage.limits: The repair adds useful reproducible variants but does not establish exhaustive coverage of every optional field/default or union form across all 16 schemas. Procedures describe manual Tools execution; no agent-call availability or dispatcher behavior is established here.

evidence: All 16 cases remain procedure-ready-unverified; no runtime result was promoted or asserted.
Member/admin execution, hosted build receipt, resource admission, reload requirements, negative-input checks, and cleanup remain stated in the procedures.
Every target feature retains explicit live tool.binding and member/admin role availability gaps; the manual runner is identified as bypassing the dispatcher Ask/Act gate.
Source schemas confirm the added scalar/array and optional-field examples. No browser, build, runtime, or database action was performed.
B_safety_quality_and_evidence.limits: This is a source and procedure review, not evidence that any procedure has passed in the product.

checks: Parsed docs/stabilization/inventory.json and confirmed exactly the 16 target cases are present with procedure-ready-unverified status.
Inspected relevant tabs handler schemas and active-tab fallback behavior.
Biome check, JSON parse, and git diff --check passed for this report.
